Agamemnon returns victorious from Troy to Argos and to the wife who has waited for him: the first play of the Oresteia.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Aeschylus (about 525–456 BC), Agamemnon (Greek), 458 BC, translated by Gilbert Murray (1866–1957), 1920. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
